pattern_name: Encapsulating ML Models within Rule-based Safeguards
pattern_motivation: It is impossible to guarantee the correctness of ML model predictions, so they should not be directly used for safety- or security-related functions. Furthermore, ML models can be unstable and vulnerable to adversarial attacks, data noise, and drift.
pattern_solution: Introduce a deterministic, rule-based mechanism that decides what to do with the prediction results, e.g., based on additional quality checks.
pattern_consequences: Reduced risk for negative impacts of incorrect predictions, but a more complex architecture.
evidence_text: [SYS01-US01-AC01] O sistema deverá responder ao atendente de acordo com os documentos oficiais da empresa; | [SYS01-US01-AC02] O sistema deverá informar o atendente que não pode ajudar, caso nenhum documento contenha a orientação para o procedimento.
rationale: The criteria require answers to follow official documents and require the system to withhold guidance when no document supports it. This establishes a safeguard against unsupported responses, consistent with the pattern’s intent.
adr_title: Document-Grounded Response Safeguards
adr_context: Store attendants need procedural guidance for handling customer requests. The system must answer according to the company's official documents and state that it cannot help when no document contains guidance for the procedure. AI-produced responses may not always satisfy these conditions, so the architecture must prevent unsupported guidance from reaching attendants.
adr_decision: We will place a deterministic, rule-based safeguard between AI-produced guidance and its delivery to store attendants. The safeguard will allow a response only when it is consistent with guidance in the company's official documents. If no official document contains guidance for the requested procedure, the system will tell the attendant that it cannot help.
adr_consequences: This will reduce the risk of attendants receiving unsupported procedural guidance, though it cannot guarantee that every permitted answer is correct. The safeguard adds architectural complexity and may prevent a response from being delivered when the AI-produced guidance does not meet its rules.

adr_title: Rejection of Unsupported Procedural Answers
adr_context: Store attendants need guidance on how to handle customer requests. The system must answer according to the company’s official documents and inform the attendant when no document contains guidance for the requested procedure. The architecture must therefore account for requests that lack a documented answer.
adr_decision: We will reject a proposed procedural answer when the company’s official documents do not support it. If no document contains guidance for the requested procedure, we will tell the attendant that the system cannot help rather than provide an unsupported answer.
adr_consequences: Attendants will not receive procedural guidance that lacks support in the official documents. Requests without documented guidance will remain unanswered, so the system’s ability to help depends on the guidance those documents contain.

adr_title: Document-Grounded Response Control
adr_context: Store attendants need answers about how to handle customer requests. The system must answer in accordance with official company documents and must say that it cannot help when no document contains guidance for the procedure. The architecture therefore needs to control when it provides procedural guidance.
adr_decision: We will apply a rule-based control to procedural responses. We will provide guidance only when an official company document contains guidance for the procedure, and we will keep the response consistent with that document. When no document contains such guidance, we will withhold procedural guidance and tell the attendant that the system cannot help.
adr_consequences: This control reduces the risk of giving attendants procedural advice unsupported by official documents. Its effectiveness depends on correctly determining whether the documents contain applicable guidance. The control cannot account for every case, and additional rules may increase operational complexity.

adr_title: Integração cliente-servidor para registro de chamados
adr_context: O atendimento de primeiro nível de TI abrange solicitações como bloqueio de sites e instalação de softwares. O sistema deve responder a procedimentos e dúvidas sobre o portfólio de serviços de TI e documentar as solicitações por meio de integração com o sistema de chamados. Essa integração exige definir qual sistema solicita o registro e qual presta esse serviço.
adr_decision: Vamos estabelecer uma relação cliente-servidor para o registro de chamados. O sistema de suporte atuará como cliente e iniciará solicitações ao sistema de chamados, que atuará como servidor e prestará o serviço de registro para documentar as solicitações dos usuários.
adr_consequences: O registro dos chamados ficará centralizado no sistema de chamados. Em contrapartida, a documentação das solicitações dependerá da disponibilidade desse sistema, e a operação do serviço de registro exigirá gestão. Essa integração não define como o sistema responderá às dúvidas e aos procedimentos do portfólio de TI.

adr_title: Adaptive Presentation of Answer Sources
adr_context: Users need to see every source used in a requested answer, including the document, version, and section of each retrieved passage. The system must report only information in the company catalog. The presentation of answers therefore needs to remain aligned with their source information.
adr_decision: We will establish a frontend AI that adapts the presentation of answers to show every source used and its document, version, and section. A backend AI will provide answers limited to the company catalog and the associated source information. An AI orchestrator will monitor both AI capabilities and oversee how their interaction evolves so that the presentation remains aligned with the answers and their sources.
adr_consequences: Users will be able to see the catalog sources behind answers, making their origins easier to understand. The frontend and backend will need to keep answer content and source details aligned. The additional frontend AI and orchestrator will also introduce monitoring and coordination responsibilities.

pattern_motivation: A system has to perform a variety of tasks of varying complexity on the data that it processes.
pattern_solution: Data is processed through a series of procedures, which have different inputs at various stages and produce incremental results as the comparison of the query images and input image takes place.
pattern_consequences: System becomes more flexible; removing, modifying and adding filters is easier than with a monolithic system
evidence_text: [SYS02-US01-AC02] O sistema deverá substituir as variáveis com o conteúdo gerado pelo modelo de IA | [SYS02-US01-AC03] O sistema deverá utilizar o layout apropriado para o tipo de documento | [SYS02-US01-AC05] O sistema deverá concatenar o texto do layout com os textos das variáveis mantendo um padrão legível e harmônico
rationale: Os critérios exigem operações distintas sobre os dados do documento: escolher o layout apropriado, substituir variáveis pelo conteúdo gerado e combinar os textos em um resultado legível. Essas transformações sucessivas correspondem à necessidade de processamento em etapas abordada por Pipes and Filters.
adr_title: Staged Generation of Procurement Documents
adr_context: The system must generate an initial document based on a record in the procurement system. It must use the administrator-registered layout appropriate to the document type, replace layout variables with AI-generated content, and produce readable, harmonious text in technical-legal language. These requirements involve distinct transformations that must work together in the final document.
adr_decision: We will generate the document through a sequence of processing stages. The stages will select the appropriate registered layout, replace its variables with AI-generated content, and combine the layout and variable text into a readable, harmonious document in technical-legal language. Each stage will pass its result to the next.
adr_consequences: Separating the transformations will make it easier to adjust one stage without changing the entire generation flow. The stages will also need to remain coordinated: a change to an intermediate result can affect the readability, formatting, or language of the final document.

pattern_motivation: The system is required to facilitate multiple views of the same data object and single view of multiple data objects.
pattern_solution: Includes three parts: Model (internal data), View (data representation) and Controller (I/O Controller). Only the model layer should be altered.
pattern_consequences: This pattern greatly enhances the code reusability and system enpansibility.
evidence_text: [SYS02-US01-AC01] O sistema deverá seguir o layout previamente cadastrado pelo administrador do sistema | [SYS02-US01-AC02] O sistema deverá substituir as variáveis com o conteúdo gerado pelo modelo de IA | [SYS02-US01-AC03] O sistema deverá utilizar o layout apropriado para o tipo de documento
rationale: The criteria distinguish generated content from its layout and require the layout to vary by document type. This provides evidence of a need to keep data separate from its representation, which is the concern addressed by MVC.
adr_title: Separate Document Content from Layout and Generation Control
adr_context: The system must generate an initial procurement document from a registered record. It must use the administrator-registered layout appropriate to the document type, replace layout variables with AI-generated content, and produce readable, coherent text in technical-legal language. These requirements distinguish the document content from its representation and from the handling of the generation request.
adr_decision: We will separate document generation into a model that holds the registered record and generated variable content, a view that represents the document using the appropriate registered layout, and a controller that coordinates the generation request and resulting document. The view will combine the layout text with substituted variable content to produce a readable, coherent document in the required technical-legal style.
adr_consequences: Separating content from its representation will make it easier to reuse generation behavior across document types and their layouts. It will also require the model, view, and controller to remain coordinated as layouts and document types change. The completed text must still be checked for readability, coherence, and technical-legal language; the separation alone does not ensure those qualities.

pattern_name:
Distinguish Business Logic from
ML Model
pattern_motivation: Machine Learning (ML) systems are complex because their ML components must be (re)trained regularly and have an intrinsic non-deterministic behavior. Similar to other systems, the business requirements for these systems as well as ML algorithms change over time.
pattern_solution:
Define clear APIs between traditional and
ML components. Place business and ML components with different responsibilities into three layers. Divide data flows into three.
pattern_consequences: Decoupling “traditional” business and ML components allows the ML components to be monitored and adjusted to meet users’ requirements and changing inputs.
evidence_text: [SYS02-US01-AC01] O sistema deverá seguir o layout previamente cadastrado pelo administrador do sistema | [SYS02-US01-AC02] O sistema deverá substituir as variáveis com o conteúdo gerado pelo modelo de IA | [SYS02-US01-AC03] O sistema deverá utilizar o layout apropriado para o tipo de documento | [SYS02-US01-AC05] O sistema deverá concatenar o texto do layout com os textos das variáveis mantendo um padrão legível e harmônico
rationale: Os critérios distinguem o conteúdo gerado pelo modelo de IA das regras para selecionar o layout cadastrado, substituir variáveis e compor o documento. Essa distinção entre responsabilidades de ML e lógica de negócio corresponde à preocupação central do padrão.
adr_title: Separação entre composição documental e geração por IA
adr_context: O documento inicial deve corresponder ao registro cadastrado no sistema de licitações, usar o layout apropriado ao tipo de documento e seguir o layout cadastrado pelo administrador. O conteúdo das variáveis será gerado pelo modelo de IA em linguagem técnico-jurídica, enquanto a substituição das variáveis e a composição do texto devem preservar a legibilidade e a harmonia do documento. Essas responsabilidades precisam permanecer distinguíveis.
adr_decision: We will separate the business logic that selects the registered layout, replaces variables, and composes the document from the AI model that generates the content for those variables. We will define a clear interface through which the generated content is provided for insertion into the appropriate layout, while preserving the required technical-legal language and a readable, harmonious result.
adr_consequences: The layout and composition rules can be maintained separately from adjustments to AI-generated content. This separation makes it clearer which responsibility to address when the document does not meet its requirements. It also requires maintaining the interface between the two responsibilities; separating them does not, by itself, ensure that generated text follows the required language standard or fits harmoniously into the layout.

adr_title: Separate Document Construction from Layout Representation
adr_context: The system must generate an initial bidding document based on a registered record. It must use the administrator-registered layout appropriate to the document type, replace layout variables with AI-generated content, and produce readable, harmonious text in technical-legal language. This requires the document’s content and layout to be brought together without treating them as the same concern.
adr_decision: We will separate construction of the initial document from its layout representation. The registered layout selected for the document type will define the representation, while document construction will replace its variables with AI-generated content and combine that content with the layout text into a readable, harmonious document in technical-legal language.
adr_consequences: Layouts can vary by document type without being conflated with the AI-generated content used to fill them. Document construction must still account for the variables in each selected layout and ensure that the combined text remains coherent and follows the required language standard; separating construction from representation does not guarantee those qualities on its own.

pattern_name: Encapsulating ML Models within Rule-based Safeguards
pattern_motivation: It is impossible to guarantee the correctness of ML model predictions, so they should not be directly used for safety- or security-related functions. Furthermore, ML models can be unstable and vulnerable to adversarial attacks, data noise, and drift.
pattern_solution: Introduce a deterministic, rule-based mechanism that decides what to do with the prediction results, e.g., based on additional quality checks.
pattern_consequences: Reduced risk for negative impacts of incorrect predictions, but a more complex architecture.
evidence_text: [SYS04-US03] Como cientista de dados ou engenheiro de controle, quero conectar modelos de controle e inteligência artificial ao gêmeo digital, para avaliar suas recomendações antes da aplicação na ETA real. | [SYS04-US03-AC02] Os comandos ou recomendações dos modelos devem ser aplicados somente ao ambiente simulado.
rationale: A história exige avaliar recomendações dos modelos antes de sua aplicação na ETA real, e o critério limita sua aplicação ao ambiente simulado. Essa restrição evidencia a necessidade de proteger a operação real dos efeitos diretos das saídas dos modelos.
adr_title: Rule-Based Safeguards for Model Evaluation
adr_context: Data scientists and control engineers need to evaluate control and AI model recommendations in the digital twin before applying them to the real ETA. Models must receive the variables expected in the real environment, but their commands and recommendations may be applied only in simulation. Each execution must be recorded, and different models must be comparable under the same scenario. Because model outputs cannot be assumed to be correct, the architecture needs to preserve the boundary between evaluation and real operation.
adr_decision: We will place a deterministic, rule-based safeguard between connected models and the application of their commands or recommendations. The safeguard will permit those outputs to affect only the simulated environment and prevent their application to the real ETA. Guarded evaluations will provide models with the variables expected in the real environment and record each execution's inputs, outputs, and results so that different models can be compared under the same scenario.
adr_consequences: Model outputs can be evaluated without directly affecting the real ETA, reducing the risk from incorrect recommendations. Recorded executions and shared scenarios support model comparison. The safeguard adds architectural complexity, and its rules must remain consistent with the simulation-only boundary.

adr_context: Control and AI models need to connect to the digital twin to evaluate their recommendations before application at the real water treatment plant. Each model needs the variables expected in the real environment, while its commands or recommendations must affect only the simulation. Evaluations must record inputs, outputs, and results and allow different models to be compared under the same scenario.
adr_decision: We will make the digital twin the server for model evaluations, with connected models acting as clients that request the expected variables and submit commands or recommendations for simulation. adr_consequences: Centralizing simulation data and execution gives connected models a consistent basis for comparison and keeps their evaluations separate from the real plant. Distinguish Business Logic from
ML Model
pattern_motivation: Machine Learning (ML) systems are complex because their ML components must be (re)trained regularly and have an intrinsic non-deterministic behavior. Similar to other systems, the business requirements for these systems as well as ML algorithms change over time.
pattern_solution:
Define clear APIs between traditional and
ML components. Place business and ML components with different responsibilities into three layers. Divide data flows into three.
pattern_consequences: Decoupling “traditional” business and ML components allows the ML components to be monitored and adjusted to meet users’ requirements and changing inputs.

adr_title: Separate Models from Digital Twin Simulation and Evaluation
adr_context: Data scientists and control engineers need to connect control and AI models to the digital twin to assess their recommendations before applying them in the real ETA. Models must receive the variables planned for the real environment, while their commands or recommendations must affect only the simulation. Each execution must be recorded, and different models must be comparable under the same scenario. These needs call for a clear boundary between model behavior and the twin’s simulation and evaluation functions.
adr_decision: We will separate simulation, connected models, and execution evaluation into three layers with explicit interfaces between the models and the other functions. The simulation layer will supply the required variables and apply model commands or recommendations only in the simulated environment. The evaluation layer will record each execution’s inputs, outputs, and results and support comparison of different models using the same scenario. Data will flow separately from the simulation to the models as inputs, from the models to the simulation as commands or recommendations, and from executions to evaluation as recorded results.
adr_consequences: Models can be changed and compared without combining their behavior with the twin’s simulation and evaluation responsibilities. Recorded executions will make their recommendations and results available for assessment before use in the real ETA. The separation also requires maintaining the interfaces and coordinating the three data flows so that models receive consistent variables and comparisons use the same scenario.

adr_context: Data scientists and control engineers need to evaluate recommendations from control and AI models in the digital twin before applying them to the real ETA. Models must receive the variables expected in the real environment, but their commands or recommendations must affect only the simulation. Each execution must also be recorded so different models can be compared using the same scenario.

adr_consequences: Models can be evaluated without their outputs affecting the real ETA, and recorded executions will support comparisons under a common scenario. The boundary adds architectural complexity and must be maintained as models are connected. adr_title: Interchangeable Models for Digital-Twin Evaluation
adr_context: Data scientists and control engineers need to connect different control and AI models to the digital twin and compare their recommendations before applying them to the real ETA. Each model must receive the variables expected in the real environment, while its commands or recommendations must affect only the simulation. Each execution must also be recorded, and models must be comparable using the same scenario.
adr_decision: We will define a common interface for control and AI models that the digital twin uses to invoke interchangeable models. The twin will provide each model with the required variables for a scenario, apply its commands or recommendations only to the simulated environment, and record the inputs, outputs, and results of each execution. This structure will allow different models to be evaluated against the same scenario.
adr_consequences: Models can be changed and compared without changing how the digital twin invokes them. Their recommendations can be evaluated without affecting the real ETA, and recorded executions will support comparison. Each model must conform to the common interface, which increases code complexity.
